fields.description:
main is RED. tests/unit/test_bug_claim_rca_sequence_docs.py::test_claim_time_exemption_type_registry_includes_bug fails on gerrit/main, and blocks every change branched from it (it is what put change 2555 at Verified -1).

## What happened

A semantic merge conflict between two changes that were each green on their own, which per-patchset CI structurally cannot catch.

- Change 2544 (another session) added the test. It asserts a literal SOURCE STRING: `_PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES = ("bug"` must appear in src/rebar/_commands/gates.py.
- Change 2530 (this epic, mirror F3) consolidated that constant into rebar.types. gates.py:31 now imports it and gates.py:48 reads `_PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES = PLAN_REVIEW_EXEMPT_TYPES`.

The literal is therefore gone (grep count 0 on gerrit/main) while the test asserting it is still present. Confirmed by running it: 1 failed, 5 passed.

## Root cause

The assertion is a CHANGE-DETECTOR: it asserts internal source TEXT rather than observable behavior, so a behavior-preserving consolidation breaks it even though the behavior it cares about — that a bug is claim-time exempt from plan review — is completely unchanged. AGENTS.md is explicit that a test which breaks under a behavior-preserving refactor should be rewritten to assert observable behavior.

## Fix

Rewrite the assertion to test the intent directly: that "bug" is in the claim-time exemption set as the code actually evaluates it, and that a bug is consequently not review-required. That is strictly STRONGER than the source-text check (it would catch a value change the string match would miss) and it survives refactors. No production behavior changes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC1: the test asserts the exemption VALUE, not source text. Verified by review of the test and by it passing on current main.
- [x] AC2: it fails if "bug" stops being claim-time exempt. Verified by a mutation removing "bug" from the exemption set and seeing RED.
- [x] AC3: it survives a behavior-preserving move of the constant. Verified by re-pointing the alias and seeing it stay green.
- [x] AC4: the other five tests in the file are untouched and still pass.

## Testing

- `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_bug_claim_rca_sequence_docs.py -q` — AC1-AC4.
- `make lint && make typecheck`.
